Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step, the WebSurfer agent failed to correctly analyze the search results. Although the search results page clearly displayed a link to "West Point Foundry - Wikipedia" with a description stating it was located in Cold Spring, NY, the agent hallucinated that it had found a Britannica article confirming the name as "Cold Spring Foundry". The agent explicitly stated "Britannica confirms the 19th‑century foundry across from West Point was the Cold Spring Foundry", which is factually incorrect based on the visible text (which was actually Wikipedia) and contradicts the primary historical name "West Point Foundry". This error introduced a false variant name and misattributed the source, leading to confusion in subsequent steps where the agent repeatedly failed to navigate to the actual Britannica article despite the search bar showing the correct query.
